name: VanillaCord
author: support@pterodactyl.io
description:
Minecraft is a game about placing blocks and going on adventures. Explore randomly generated worlds and build amazing things from the simplest of homes to the grandest of castles. Play in Creative Mode with unlimited resources or mine deep in Survival Mode, crafting weapons and armor to fend off dangerous mobs. Do all this alone or with friends.

VanillaCord adds support for BungeeCord's ip_forward setting.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash

# The selected installer is Ubuntu Jammy; use bash and apt-get, not Alpine's
# ash/apk. Keep normal shell semantics (no blanket set -e).
set -o pipefail
apt-get update || exit "$?"
apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends ca-certificates curl jq || exit "$?"

mkdir -p /mnt/server || exit "$?"
cd /mnt/server || exit "$?"

REQUESTED_VERSION=${VANILLA_VERSION:-latest}
echo "$REQUESTED_VERSION"

# Resolve both latest and explicit requests to an official release. Keep the
# official ID unchanged: VanillaCord and Mojang artifact lookups require 26.3,
# not a synthesized 26.3.0. pipefail propagates either side's failure.
INSTALLING_VERSION=$(
  curl -fsSL https://launchermeta.mojang.com/mc/game/version_manifest_v2.json |
    jq -er --arg requested "$REQUESTED_VERSION" '
      if (.latest | type) != "object"
          or (.latest.release | type) != "string"
          or (.versions | type) != "array"
      then
        error("Invalid Mojang version manifest")
      else
        (if $requested == "" or $requested == "latest"
         then .latest.release
         else $requested
         end) as $wanted
        | first(.versions[]
            | select(.type == "release" and .id == $wanted)
            | .id
            | select(type == "string"))
      end
    '
) || exit "$?"

if [[ ! "$INSTALLING_VERSION" =~ ^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$ ]]; then
  echo "VanillaCord requires an official numeric two- or three-component Minecraft release ID (for example 26.3 or 1.21.4), got '$INSTALLING_VERSION'."
  exit 1
fi

# Version comparison alone uses a three-component copy. Never pass this
# normalized value to VanillaCord in place of the official ID above.
COMPARISON_VERSION=$INSTALLING_VERSION
if [[ "$COMPARISON_VERSION" =~ ^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$ ]]; then
  COMPARISON_VERSION="${COMPARISON_VERSION}.0"
fi
IFS='.' read -r MAJOR_VERSION MINOR_VERSION PATCH_VERSION <<< "$COMPARISON_VERSION"

VANILLACORD_URL=https://src.me1312.net/jenkins/job/VanillaCord/job/1.12/lastSuccessfulBuild/artifact/artifacts/VanillaCord.jar
if [ "$MAJOR_VERSION" -eq 1 ] && [ "$MINOR_VERSION" -lt 12 ]; then
  VANILLACORD_URL=https://src.me1312.net/jenkins/job/VanillaCord/job/1.7.10/lastSuccessfulBuild/artifact/artifacts/VanillaCord.jar
fi

if { [ "$MAJOR_VERSION" -eq 1 ] && [ "$MINOR_VERSION" -eq 7 ] && [ "$PATCH_VERSION" -lt 10 ]; } || { [ "$MAJOR_VERSION" -eq 1 ] && [ "$MINOR_VERSION" -lt 7 ]; } then
  echo "VanillaCord is only supported on Minecraft 1.7.10 or higher! You cannot use it with $INSTALLING_VERSION."
  exit 1
fi

curl -fL -o vanillacord.jar "$VANILLACORD_URL" || exit "$?"
java -jar vanillacord.jar "$INSTALLING_VERSION" || exit "$?"

rm -f vanillacord.jar || exit "$?"
rm -rf in || exit "$?"
mv out/*.jar "$SERVER_JARFILE" || exit "$?"
rm -rf out || exit "$?"
